g.text: The collection thins after the 1960s, and Le Journal de Montréal (1964 on) is absent or can be read only on BAnQ's premises:

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #52514e

g.text: fewer marks after 1970 reflect, at least in part, fewer papers to search.

g.text: Newspaper issues returned by the 17 searches, by decade of the issue: what there was to read

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Cyclists under 15 killed on the island of Montréal, as reported in digitized newspapers

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: One mark per death, by year of the event. 69 deaths: 64 with the place printed or the streets named (filled), 5 placed on the island by inference (hollow).

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Source: newspapers digitized by BAnQ numérique, 17 fixed searches, every candidate read on the page (protocol and table of events in this folder). Other vehicle as the page describes it;

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #52514e

g.text: horse-drawn only where the page says so. Not shown: deaths listed apart (a drowning, a child of 4 on a tricycle), cyclists aged 15 to 17, deaths with the collision off the island.
